albums.title: Coal Mines Field Visit
albums.description: Fieldwork at Aditya Birla TMC coal mines in Bicharpur, Shahdol, Madhya Pradesh. Sampling and hydrogeochemical analysis of mine water and surrounding water bodies.

albums.title: Bhitarkanika Mangrove Fieldwork
albums.description: Seasonal fieldwork in Bhitarkanika National Park, Odisha — one of India's largest mangrove ecosystems. Hydrogeochemical sampling and water quality analysis across summer, monsoon, and winter seasons.
